settle().notice: Settle the current trading day. Settlement includes the following changes         to the fund.         1. endOfWeek(uint256).notice: Return end timestamp of the trading week containing a given timestamp.         A trading week starts at UTC time `SETTLEMENT_TIME` on a Thursday (inclusive)         and ends at the same time of the next Thursday (exclusive).

extrapolateNav(uint256).notice: Estimate the current NAV of all tranches, considering underlying price change,         and accrued interest since the previous settlement. historicalUnderlying(uint256).notice: Mapping of trading day => underlying assets in the fund.         Key is the end timestamp of a trading day. Value is the underlying assets in         the fund after settlement of that trading day.

underlyingDecimalMultiplier().notice: A multipler that normalizes an underlying balance to 18 decimal places.

getRebalanceTimestamp(uint256).notice: Return timestamp of the transaction triggering the rebalance at a given index.         Zero is returned if `index` is out of bound.

historicalInterestRate(uint256).notice: Mapping of trading week => interest rate of BISHOP.         Key is the end timestamp of a trading day. Value is the interest rate captured         after settlement of that day, which will be effective until the next settlement.

refreshBalance(address,uint256).notice: Transform share balance to a given rebalance version, or to the latest version         if `targetVersion` is zero.

historicalEquivalentTotalB(uint256).notice: Mapping of trading day => equivalent BISHOP supply.         Key is the end timestamp of a trading day. Value is the total supply of BISHOP,         as if all QUEEN are split.

refreshAllowance(address,address,uint256.notice: Transform allowance to a given rebalance version, or to the latest version         if `targetVersion` is zero.

Split ratio, NAV, rounding, fees and rebalance state determine tranche results; split/merge have no caller min-output or deadline.

Redeem and redeemAndUnwrapWstETH require immutable redemptionFlag and enough fund underlying to satisfy all queued redemptions first. queueRedemption burns QUEEN immediately and fixes an underlying claim, not immediate payment; claims require increasing unique indices belonging to account and sufficient liquidity to pop all earlier queue entries. Anyone can trigger a claim but proceeds always go to the recorded account, including fixed wstETH unwrapping to stETH. No fixed claim delay or payment guarantee.

Creation/redeem conversion floors at underlying/share exchange rate; exact-output quote helpers can round and are not transaction guarantees. Redemption and merge fee rates are owner-mutable, source-capped at 1%; explorer snapshot reported both zero, redemptionFlag=true and fund frozen=false on observation. These are point-in-time explorer values, not persistent runtime state. Fund owner may change primaryMarket/strategy after a proposal delay and may replace oracles; source initial strategy is zero. Annual settlementPeriod=31536000 is a recurring accounting period, not an expired individual loan.

primaryMarket.underlying: wstETH tokenUnderlying from Fund constructor. WstETH unwrapWstETH variants call unwrap to stETH; ETH withdraw variants incompatible.

fund.lifecycle: settle updates currentDay=day+settlementPeriod, so annual settlement is recurring, not end-of-life maturity. freeze requires ROOK nav zero; observed frozen getter False.
fund.current-vs-constructor: Official/current getter primaryMarket and constructor agree, but governor may change after 3-day min / 15-day max proposal window. No perpetual identity assumption.
